classification.difficultyReason: Read perpendicular heights and parallel sides, select the appropriate area formula including the trapezium formula, then simplify surd products and rationalise denominators.

content.prompt: Determine the exact value of the area of the following shapes. Express your answers using a rational denominator.

spec.description: Unshaded right triangle with horizontal base, vertical right side and lower-right right-angle marker. Ordinary source-blue outlines use house black.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and right-angle marker are permanent givens; no area answer appears.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral with four right-angle markers and matching single ticks on the vertical sides. Ordinary source-blue outlines use house black.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal length 2/sqrt(6) m; vertical length sqrt(2/3) m. Both dimensions equal sqrt(6)/3 m.
spec.answerVisibility: All dimensions and marks are permanent givens; no area answer appears.

spec.description: Unshaded trapezium with matching right-pointing parallel marks, red dashed perpendicular height and right-angle marker at its foot. Ordinary source-blue edges and parallel marks use house black.
spec.mathematics: Parallel lengths sqrt(2) mm and sqrt(3) mm; perpendicular height 1/sqrt(5) mm.
spec.answerVisibility: Lengths, parallel marks and height are permanent givens; no area answer appears.
